newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 26,000T white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 26,000T white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's general foreign trade organisation for chemicals and foodstuffs (GEZA) has issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar, a GEZA spokesman said on Saturday.
He said that January 8 was set as final date to receive price offers and that the two amounts should be shipped during February 1997.
Results of the tender would be made on January 9, the official said.
